verdict.rationale: A financial infrastructure platform could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, such as scheduled or recurring money movement, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such feature. The only nearby items are a marketing line about "flows to automate lending and repayments" and a bare webhooks page title; both are adjacent features, not user-defined autonomous automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
